mapper.sql: select template_id, template_code, channel, template_name, category, platform_template_id, cast(field_map as text) as field_map, content, link, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from abr_message_template
mapper.insert: insert into abr_message_template (template_code, channel, template_name, category, platform_template_id, field_map, content, link, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{templateCode}, #{channel}, #{templateName}, #{category}, coalesce(#{platformTemplateId}, ''), cast(#{fieldMap} as jsonb), coalesce(#{content}, ''), coalesce(#{link}, ''), #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_message_template set template_code = #{templateCode}, channel = #{channel}, template_name = #{templateName}, category = #{category}, platform_template_id = coalesce(#{platformTemplateId}, ''), field_map = cast(#{fieldMap} as jsonb), content = coalesce(#{content}, ''), link = coalesce(#{link}, ''), status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where template_id = #{templateId}
mapper.delete: delete from abr_message_template where template_id in #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into abr_message_send (template_code, channel, category, target_type, target_id, recipient, agent_code, task_id, status, reason, platform_msg_id, rendered, create_by, create_time) values (#{templateCode}, coalesce(#{channel}, ''), coalesce(#{category}, ''), #{targetType}, #{targetId}, coalesce(#{recipient}, ''), coalesce(#{agentCode}, ''), #{taskId}, #{status}, coalesce(#{reason}, ''), coalesce(#{platformMsgId}, ''), coalesce(#{rendered}, ''), coalesce(#{createBy}, 'system'), now())
mapper.select: select oa_openid as "oaOpenid", mini_openid as "miniOpenid", phone as "phone", status as "status" from abr_app_user where app_user_id = #{appUserId} and del_flag = '0'

with recursive chain(lead_id, merged_into, depth) as ( select lead_id, merged_into, 0 from abr_lead where lead_id = #{leadId} union all select l.lead_id, l.merged_into, c.depth + 1 from abr_lead l join chain c on l.lead_id = c.merged_into where c.depth < 10 ) select l.app_user_id as "appUserId", l.phone as "phone" from chain c join abr_lead l on l.lead_id = c.lead_id where c.merged_into is null and l.del_flag = '0' limit 1
select app_user_id from abr_visitor where visitor_id = #{visitorId}
select user_name from sys_user where user_id = #{userId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'

select u.user_id from sys_user u where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and (u.user_id = 1 or exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' join sys_role_menu rm on rm.role_id = r.role_id join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id and m.status = '0' where ur.user_id = u.user_id and m.perms = #{perms})) order by u.user_id
